name: Kokuminteki Idol Group o Saiminjutsu de Yaritai Houdai ~Saimin ADV Game~
original_name: 国民的アイドルグループを催眠術でやりたい放題～催眠ADVゲーム
source:
Bankrupt talent agency director Takarada of YPA Ltd. owes $10 million in short term loans.
To raise the cash he pulls out all the stops, using devious hypnotic tricks to manipulate rival idols, scandalize them, extport money, threaten producers and win a general election with his own unpopular girls at the very top. Whatever it takes to get that $10 million!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE119470.html]DLsite English[/url]]
